summary: The <prior-attempt> bullets state each captured text's bound and which end survives; `details` stops reading as "full"

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: Every field the writer bounds — `details`, `diffStat`, `finalMessage`, `failureClass`, `failures`, `threw` — carries its bound and its surviving end on its own bullet under *The `<prior-attempt>` block*, and `details`'s "full" is gone. The pin reads the page against what the real writer emits over an over-long input, never against prose.

notes: Verified on disk: `src/bounds.ts:11` — a bounded string reading as a whole one is the false signal the bound must not introduce — while the page calls `details` "full" and `src/priorAttempts.ts:895` head-tail-bounds it at 8 KiB. `diffStat` (`:853`), `failureClass` (`:948`), `failures` (`:968`), `threw` (`:1027`) are silent on the page; `finalMessage` (`:934`) keeps the tail, the rest the head. `touchedPaths`/`omittedPaths` shipped in f1b120d6 is the shape to generalize.
